dialogue.realtalk: I was hoping you'd stop by! Pull up a chair, %1$s — there's bread if you want it. What's on your mind?
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: So good, honestly! The oven's been kind, the neighbors kinder, and now you're here. Full week!
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: A heavy stretch, truth be told. But you asking? That warms me like fresh bread, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: Lovely day! Traded eggs for honey at the well, and everyone had a minute to chat. My favorite kind.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: A stumbly one — burnt the porridge, tripped over the cat. Nothing warm supper and good company won't mend!
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: I do! You see everybody's faces, hear the news, share a laugh. The work's mostly the excuse, really.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: Between friends? Not much. But the folk I do it alongside make it worth showing up. That's the trick.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: Nobody's asked in ages! Get comfortable — it's a long one, with three good harvests and a lot of shared suppers in it.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: A table long enough for the whole village. Everybody fed, nobody hurrying. You'd have a seat, of course.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: Honestly? An empty chair at supper. Folks drifting off one by one till it's just me and the kettle.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: Oh, you're family already, %1$s — didn't you know? The door's never locked for you.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: Ah, that's kitchen-table talk, and we're still at the front gate! Come by more — the kettle's always on.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: That's a story for old friends by a low fire, %1$s. We're getting there. Keep coming around, I mean it.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: Quiet week! Everyone's fine, fed, and boring — which is the best news a village can have, honestly.
dialogue.chat: There you are! I was JUST telling the kettle we were due a proper talk, %1$s. Come in, come in.
